subject: Important Update: Changes to our Customer Support Hours
body: Dear valued customers, we wanted to inform you about some changes to our customer support hours. Starting next month, our customer support team will be available from 8am to 6pm EST, Monday to Friday. We hope this adjustment will better serve your needs and improve our response times. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. Thank you for your continued support and understanding.
